title: Two-Factor Prognostic Model for Diabetic Foot Ulcer Healing by 16 Weeks
description: This knowledge object estimates the model-based probability that one diabetic foot ulcer will heal by 16 weeks, using only wound area and wound duration measured at the first clinical visit. It is a categorical pretreatment prognosis; not a continuous individualized risk equation, treatment-effect estimate, HBOT eligibility decision, or treatment recommendation.
